history.content: I own a legacy ERP developed on the Genero 4js platform coded in 4GL. It dates the '90s and though it is robust and trustable, our customers expect it to get modernized, at least changing the UX/UI. But this change does not seem to be easy. We attempted some years ago to develop a new modern web user interface and it was architecturally almost impossible to be done in less than 4 years. Would you be able to help here?

Hi Eduardo,

Thank you for reaching out and sharing details about your Genero 4js ERP. It’s impressive that a system built in the ’90s remains so reliable, and we understand how critical a modern UX/UI has become for your customers. At Ragtime-Pro, we help legacy vendors like Almendro adopt a step-by-step approach that avoids full rewrites. For example, we often begin with personal productivity enhancements—smart suggestions, guided inputs, semantic search—that live alongside your existing interface to deliver immediate usability improvements without destabilizing your core architecture. These quick wins both satisfy users and build momentum toward deeper modernization. You can learn more about this approach on our personal productivity page: https://www.ragtime.pro/solutions/personal-productivity. We will follow up with you directly soon via the contact details you provided to discuss a practical roadmap tailored to your ERP.

Best regards,
The Ragtime-Pro Team

Thanks for your prompt reply. It is not clear to me though, whether fully redevelop a new modern web UI keeping the underlying business logic is possible or not in Genero. Can AI help develop that interface?
BR,Eduardo

Hello Eduardo,

Thank you again for sharing the details of your legacy Genero 4js ERP and your modernization goals. Just a friendly heads-up: the noreply@ragtime.pro address doesn’t accept incoming messages and isn’t monitored by our team. If you’d like an interactive conversation, please visit https://www.ragtime.pro and click the chat icon, or reach out via our contact form at https://www.ragtime.pro/contact or email info@ragtime.pro directly. We look forward to connecting with you soon!

Warm regards,
The Ragtime-Pro Team

Thanks for your prompt reply. It is not clear to me though, whether fully redevelop a new modern web UI keeping the underlying business logic is possible or not in Genero. Can AI help develop that interface?
BR,Eduardo

Hi Eduardo,

Thank you for your follow-up. Redeveloping a modern web UI on top of your existing Genero business logic is indeed possible without a full rewrite, and AI can play a key role in accelerating that process. At Ragtime-Pro, our AI-augmented Modernization Agent can analyze your current Genero 4js application, generate web component scaffolding, suggest UI patterns, and even produce code snippets that map to your business rules. We guide this work through our Product Modernization Triad—identifying the highest-impact UI boost points, matching them to the right AI-driven solution, and ensuring your architecture, APIs, and data are ready for safe integration.

By breaking the UI transformation into incremental AI Upgrade Modules, you avoid destabilizing your core logic while delivering a fresh, responsive front end much faster than a traditional multi-year rewrite. You can find a high-level overview of our methodology at https://www.ragtime.pro/methodology.

If you’d like to discuss a tailored roadmap and see AI in action on your Genero platform, please get in touch via our contact form at https://www.ragtime.pro/contact or email us at info@ragtime.pro, and we’ll coordinate a time for an introductory call. We look forward to partnering with you on this journey.

The Ragtime-Pro Team
